Salesforce Object: HealthcareProviderTaxonomy (a link from the Provider's Healthcare Provider to a NUCC taxonomy record, verifiable__VfiNUCCTaxonomy__c)
Salesforce Field Label: NUCC Taxonomy, Taxonomy Code, Primary Taxonomy
When Written: Insert and update: links the specialty and marks it primary
Stored As: <label>:<NUCC taxonomy code>, e.g. Family Medicine Physician:207Q00000X. Only the code after the last ':' is used; a value with no ':' is taken as the code. Code matching ignores case.
If Invalid: Value ignored; row still ingested; warning UNKNOWN_SPECIALTY (no such code, or no code in the value) or AMBIGUOUS_SPECIALTY (several taxonomy records share the code)
Notes: If the Provider's primary was a different specialty, that one stays linked but is no longer primary. If the specialty is already linked as secondary, it is marked primary (no second link). New links: Name = the taxonomy's name, Active = true, AccountId left blank. Links are never removed. Existing links are found by Taxonomy Code, so a link whose NUCC Taxonomy lookup was cleared (the taxonomy was deleted and reloaded) has it refilled. A link that fails to save: warning SPECIALTY_NOT_SAVED; the Provider is still saved. The separator is ProviderCsvMapping.SPECIALTY_CODE_SEPARATOR (assumed format, 2026-10-20).

If two Providers end up with the same CAQH ID, both save, but once the first has been updated, every later update of the second fails, even an unrelated one such as a new phone number, with an unclear error: 'Sync Individual Provider to Healthcare Provider' process failed ...
